translations.web: He has brought the high fortress of your walls down, laid low, and brought to the ground, even to the dust.
translations.bsb: The high-walled fortress will be brought down, cast to the ground, into the dust.
translations.kjv: And the fortress of the high fort of thy walls shall he bring down, lay low, and bring to the ground, even to the dust.
translations.asv: And the high fortress of thy walls hath he brought down, laid low, and brought to the ground, even to the dust.
